breaking_news.headline: Karl Kani dressed hip-hop royalty for decades. Now he's telling his own story
breaking_news.summary: On NPR's Morning Edition, fashion designer Karl Kani talks about his new memoir, dressing some of hip-hop's biggest stars and why skinny jeans aren't for everyone.

breaking_news.headline: Anthropic IPO raises record $81.3 billion on strong AI demand
breaking_news.summary: The five-year-old artificial intelligence powerhouse priced its initial public offering at $83 a share, shrugging off growing concern about a possible AI bubble and volatility in tech stocks.

breaking_news.headline: Investors scramble for a piece of AI giant Anthropic in blockbuster IPO
breaking_news.summary: Shares in the maker of the popular Claude artificial intelligence model leapt in first day of trading on the Nasdaq Thursday.

breaking_news.headline: Anthropic raises more than $100B in IPO. And, Dems nominate Jeffries for House speaker
breaking_news.summary: Despite growing concern over a possible AI bubble, Anthropic had a record-breaking initial public offering. And, Hakeem Jeffries could become the first Black Speaker of the House.

breaking_news.headline: AI giant Anthropic's shares pop in debut after blockbuster IPO
breaking_news.summary: Shares in the AI juggernaut Anthropic are now trading on the stock market. They debuted Thursday, after a record-breaking IPO.

breaking_news.headline: How exactly did Trump get so rich on crypto? We explain
breaking_news.summary: President Trump has made billions of dollars in his second term — most of it in cryptocurrencies. Democrats are vowing to probe his businesses as they gear up to take over Congress next year.

breaking_news.headline: Critics are worried about Anthropic's influence after first day of public trading
breaking_news.summary: Anthropic's initial public offering was a success for shareholders, including its founders. But there were also protests about whether the company can be a responsible steward of AI technology.

breaking_news.headline: Just how vulnerable are we to cyberattacks?
breaking_news.summary: In a week of outages, we're thinking about the rising threat of AI-powered cyberattacks. But sometimes, it's not the most sophisticated attack that's concerning, but the easy targets buried in old software.

breaking_news.headline: White House removes cyber-security chief after series of tech outages
breaking_news.summary: CBS is reporting he has been fired after losing the confidence of White House chief of staff Stephen Miller.

breaking_news.headline: South Korea catches 111 students with new measures against exam cheating

breaking_news.headline: Catherine Zeta-Jones' daughter says parents warned her about 'nepo baby' label
breaking_news.summary: Carys Douglas, 23, made her stage debut this year in Anton Chekhov's play, The Seagull, in the US.

breaking_news.headline: Texas death-row inmate screams as execution takes more than one hour
breaking_news.summary: This prolonged execution comes weeks after Christa Pike survived the lethal injection of the same drug.

breaking_news.headline: Nearly 600 women killed in South Africa within three months
breaking_news.summary: Police officials called for "greater efforts to prevent... violence" against women and children.

breaking_news.headline: Russia targets Kyiv crossings days after Ukraine hits Crimean Bridge

breaking_news.summary: Nobody was hurt and no damage has been reported, but Warsaw described the incident as a "provocation" from Moscow.

breaking_news.headline: Tens of thousands of UK fridges secured from hackers in secret nationwide operation
breaking_news.summary: Supermarkets, warehouses, restaurants and stadiums have been scrambling to make their devices safe.

breaking_news.headline: Mouldy, infested housing for vulnerable people sold as ethical investments abroad
